children: RCI Hospitality Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: RICK) is pleased to announce PT’s Showclub in Indianapolis was named Small Club of the Year, Central Region, at the Annual Gentlemen’s Club EXPO awards show in Las Vegas.

The event, held last week at Penn & Teller Theater in the Rio Hotel & Casino, is the premier national awards program for the billion-dollar adult nightclub industry. Winners are determined through voting by thousands of industry professionals.
Established in 1998, the awards show is the marquee event of EXPO, the only national convention and tradeshow for the industry since its inception in 1993.

“Congratulations to the PT’s team,” said Dean Reardon, President of Operations. “We are extremely proud of what they have accomplished. They have transformed PT’s into a high-energy, entertaining destination known for outstanding hospitality and a strong lineup of performers. We thank them for their hard work and dedication.”

Reardon added, “This award was just one of the many highlights of this year’s EXPO. It was an outstanding convention and a great opportunity to connect with colleagues from across the country, exchange ideas, and explore new ways to help grow and strengthen the industry.”
